experiments.hypothesis: Adding a tutorial overlay will increase new-player retention in the first session.
experiments.variantA: No tutorial — players dropped into the game immediately.
experiments.variantB: Interactive 3-step tutorial overlay on first load.
experiments.changelog: Added interactive tutorial overlay for new players.

experiments.hypothesis: Brighter color palette will make the game feel more energetic and increase session duration.
experiments.changelog: Switched to vibrant, high-saturation color palette.

experiments.hypothesis: Adding sound effects on key actions will improve immersion and increase play time.
experiments.variantB: Subtle sound effects on score, collision, and power-up events.
experiments.changelog: Added sound effects for score, collision, and power-up events.

experiments.hypothesis: A persistent high-score leaderboard will drive competitive replay behavior.
experiments.variantB: Persistent top-10 leaderboard visible after each game.
experiments.changelog: Added persistent top-10 leaderboard after each game.

experiments.hypothesis: Faster game speed will create more excitement and longer sessions.
experiments.changelog: Kept current game speed — faster speed reduced session time.

experiments.hypothesis: Adding a 'daily challenge' mode will bring players back and increase session count.
experiments.variantB: Added daily challenge with unique constraints each day.
experiments.changelog: Introduced daily challenge mode with unique daily constraints.

experiments.hypothesis: Particle effects on scoring events will feel more rewarding and keep players engaged.
experiments.variantB: Burst particle effects and screen shake on scoring.
experiments.changelog: Added particle burst effects and screen shake on scoring events.

experiments.hypothesis: Reducing ad frequency will decrease friction and increase play time despite lower ad revenue.
experiments.changelog: Reduced ad frequency from every 3 games to every 6.

experiments.hypothesis: Unlockable character skins will give players a progression goal and increase return visits.
experiments.changelog: Added 5 unlockable character skins earned via gameplay milestones.

experiments.hypothesis: Background music will create atmosphere and increase immersion.
experiments.variantA: Sound effects only, no background music.
experiments.variantB: Ambient looping background track with volume control.
experiments.changelog: Kept sound-effects-only approach — background music slightly reduced session time.

experiments.hypothesis: A 'share your score' button will drive organic traffic and create social engagement loops.
experiments.variantB: Share-to-clipboard button with auto-generated score card.
experiments.changelog: Added share-to-clipboard with auto-generated score card image.

experiments.hypothesis: Adaptive difficulty that scales with player skill will keep sessions longer by maintaining flow state.
experiments.variantB: Dynamic difficulty adjustment based on recent performance.
